info.name: Microsoft Azure Enables Automatic Scaling For A Pool

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for this operation.

params.name: timeOut
params.description: The maximum time that the server can spend processing the request, in seconds. The default is 30 seconds. If the value is larger than 30, the default will be used instead.".

params.name: poolId
params.description: The ID of the Pool to get.

items.docs:
You cannot enable automatic scaling on a Pool if a resize operation is in
progress on the Pool. If automatic scaling of the Pool is currently disabled,
you must specify a valid autoscale formula as part of the request. If automatic
scaling of the Pool is already enabled, you may specify a new autoscale formula
and/or a new evaluation interval. You cannot call this API for the same Pool
more than once every 30 seconds.

the result without applying the formula to the Pool. The Pool must have auto
scaling enabled in order to evaluate a formula.

already resizing, the request fails with status code 409. When you resize a

resize Pools which are configured for automatic scaling. If you try to do this,
the Batch service returns an error 409. If you resize a Pool downwards, the

operation: it only stops any further changes being made, and the Pool maintains
its current state. After stopping, the Pool stabilizes at the number of Compute
